fields.name: classes_dark

fields.description: White text on a black band across the page

fields.name: summary

fields.description: Up to 120 characters, the line that opens and closes the item.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the title to 120 characters at most.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Content
fields.description: Up to 600 characters, shown when the item is open. Longer content is shortened on the page.

fields.name: color
fields.label: Background colour
fields.description: A hex colour, e.g. #df9926

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description:
Default - a grid of cards.
Carousel - auto-rotates; recommended: 6 to 12 cards.
Timeline - 6 to 10 cards.
Pillars - up to 6 cards, JPG or PNG images only.
Roller - 3 to 6 cards, one per scroll step.
Rail - a horizontally scrolling row of fixed-width cards, any number.
Features - cards that open their details in a pop-up, with a Next button to the next card.
  Image cards (Technology, Safety), any number, in a sideways-scrolling row: the picture fills the card; its title shows on one line, its short line on two; the rest shows in the pop-up (title 2 lines, text 6 lines on phones, 8 on desktop).
  Stat tiles (Performance), 1 or more: 1 to 4 tiles fill the row; with 5 or more, 4 show at a time (pages of 4, 2 x 2, on phones) and arrows move to the rest. Value in bold, up to 16 characters (e.g. 590 Nm); label up to 2 lines; in the pop-up, title up to 3 lines and description up to 250 characters. The section's figure: up to 4 digits and a 4-letter unit (e.g. 359 PS).
  Longer texts end in … on the page (Universal Editor shows them whole). Card text order: see the card's Text field.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Pillars: 1. Label 2. Heading 3. Description, opening words in bold. Timeline: 1. Title as a heading, 2. Description 3. Location in italics. Roller: 1. Title as a heading 2. Description. Carousel in a Light section: 1. Label 2. Title as a heading 3. Description 4. Link. Features: 1. Title as a heading (image card, one line), or in bold for a stat tile (up to 16 characters, e.g. 590 Nm) 2. Short line (two lines) 3. and on: the detail, shown with the image when the card is opened; a heading first is the detail title (up to 3 lines on a stat tile), and a stat tile shows up to 250 characters of the rest. Longer texts end in … on the page.

fields.name: position
fields.label: Place in the design
fields.description: Each place holds one image; an image without a place is not shown.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Default is a standard columns layout. Thank You is a full-bleed split (image + centered content) on a dark surface. Reach Us is the Contact Us layout (use 3 columns × 2 rows): it also styles the Title above and the Text below it in the same section and adds a live IST clock. Split is two full-screen video panes side by side (2 columns): each column a link to an MP4, a heading, bold-first stat lines (e.g. **1100+ KM** range), a heading and text for its card; an optional 2nd row is a film card (image | eyebrow, line, MP4 link, then a heading and text for the film). Reach Us (Photo) is the Reach Us layout over a dark photo instead of the gradient: put an Image (and optionally a Text with a link to an MP4, for a muted looping film) alone in one cell, e.g. the empty first cell of the second row.

validation.customErrorMsg: City can only contain letters and spaces.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Event Description
fields.description: Recommended character limit: 35 characters.

fields.name: links
fields.label: Links
fields.description: As anywhere on the site: bold = primary button, italic = secondary, plain = text link; with no button, the last link is the primary one. Brochure: its two links on one line, then a line with the label.

fields.name: mobileImage
fields.label: Background Image or Video (Mobile)
fields.description: Optional. Uses the desktop one if empty.

fields.name: thumbnail
fields.label: Video Thumbnail (Desktop)
fields.description: Optional. Only used for a video: the image shown until it plays. Product: the image of the Watch the film card. Dealer: the image of the product card, bottom right.

fields.name: mobileThumbnail
fields.label: Video Thumbnail (Mobile)
fields.description: Optional. Only used for a video on mobile. Uses the desktop thumbnail if empty.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Heading, text and buttons. Carousel: shown on every slide without its own Text (with Opening Animation, its first two paragraphs are the animation's lines). Tech Slides: shown below every slide; key and value paragraph pairs (e.g. Battery / 26.7 kWh) become stat tiles, then the button. Product, in this order: title (Heading 1), a link to the film's MP4 (its text is the card's eyebrow, e.g. Watch the film) and the card's text in the next paragraph, the price line (amount in bold), then the button. Dealer, in this order: the status line (e.g. Closed today · Opens Monday, 10am), the dealer's name (Heading 1), the address, the two buttons in one paragraph, then the product card's paragraphs: its title (e.g. [ New ] Combat), the price line and a line of text.

fields.name: manifesto
fields.label: Scroll Manifesto (Editorial and Intro)
fields.description: Editorial and Intro styles only. Appears on scroll.

fields.name: backgroundImage
fields.label: Background Image
fields.description: Showcase only. Optional. A decorative layer behind the main image, e.g. a sky behind a cut-out car photo.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo (Product)
fields.description: Product only. The model's logo or lockup, shown above the title.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Hero layout. Carousel and Tech Slides take up to 3 slides. Product: a car launch hero with the logo and a big centred title, a Watch the film card and the price beside the button. Its Background Image is the whole scene (e.g. the car in its landscape); the Logo has its own field. Dealer: a dealer storefront hero with the status line, name, address and two buttons bottom left, and a product card (the Video Thumbnail and the paragraphs after the buttons) bottom right.

fields.name: classes_opening
fields.label: Opening Animation
fields.description: Carousel only. On load the first slide plays in a small card in the middle of the screen, then grows to fill it. The first two Text paragraphs appear either side of the card, and only there (screen readers still get them).

fields.name: classes_showroom
fields.label: Showroom Layout
fields.description: Carousel only. The Text stays beside every slide: its first paragraphs are the eyebrow above the slide's heading, and each paragraph that starts with a bold label (e.g. **Address** Plot 14, Sector 54) becomes a row of the info card under the slide's text. Each slide's own Text gives its heading and description.

fields.name: classes_thumbs-bottom
fields.label: Thumbnails at the Bottom
fields.description: Carousel only. Moves the thumbnails to a row at the bottom right and keeps the heading and text clear of them and of the Test Drive strip.

fields.name: classes_align
fields.label: Heading Position
fields.description: Where the heading sits: left, centre or right. Only the heading moves; the text and buttons stay where the style puts them. Default keeps the style's own layout.

fields.name: mobileImage
fields.label: Background Image or Video (Mobile)
fields.description: Optional. Uses the desktop one if empty.

fields.name: thumbnail
fields.label: Thumbnail (Desktop)
fields.description: Optional. Tech Slides: the close-up tile. Carousel: the video's poster and slide strip image.

fields.name: mobileThumbnail
fields.label: Thumbnail (Mobile)
fields.description: Carousel: only used for a video on mobile. Uses the desktop thumbnail if empty. Optional.

fields.name: videoControls
fields.label: Enable Video Control
fields.description: Shows mute and pause buttons when this slide is a video.

fields.name: text
fields.label: Text
fields.description: Optional. Heading, text and buttons for this slide. Uses the Hero's Text if empty. Tech Slides: label, heading, description, stats (e.g. Battery / 26.7 kWh) and a button.

fields.name: tilePosition
fields.label: Tile Position
fields.description: Tech Slides only. Written as: x, y (e.g. 33, 61). You can drag the tile to any position in preview mode.

validation.customErrorMsg: Write it as x, y: two numbers from 0 to 100, e.g. 33, 61.

fields.name: tilePositionMobile
fields.label: Tile Position (Mobile)
fields.description: Tech Slides only. Optional, written as: x, y. Uses Tile Position if empty. Drag the tile at mobile size in preview mode.

validation.customErrorMsg: Write it as x, y: two numbers from 0 to 100, e.g. 50, 70.

fields.label: Label
fields.description: e.g. Follow Us

fields.description: A legal link (e.g. Terms of Use) or the copyright line

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Up to 40 characters, so the title fits the card on every screen.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the title to 40 characters at most.

fields.name: media_thumbnail
fields.label: Thumbnail
fields.description: Required: the item needs its thumbnail.

fields.name: media_image
fields.label: Showcase image
fields.description: Required: the item needs its showcase image.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Title
fields.description: Up to 40 characters, so the title fits the card on every screen.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the title to 40 characters at most.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: Up to 160 characters, so the description fits the card on every screen.

validation.customErrorMsg: Keep the description to 160 characters at most.

fields.name: hotspots
fields.label: Hotspots (+ points)
fields.description: Up to 6 bullets, one per + point, written as: x, y | TITLE | description. You can drag the + points to any position in preview mode. A maximum of 6 hotspots is allowed.

fields.name: label

fields.description: The text of the link, e.g. Confluence Day 1

fields.name: anchor

fields.name: target
fields.label: Goes to section

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Gallery ID
fields.description: Different for each gallery on the page, e.g. day2; its popups are named after it

fields.name: photos
fields.label: Photos
fields.description: The photos the card opens, in order

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image Alt Text
fields.description: Describe the image for screen readers and SEO.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading & Intro
fields.value:
Be the first to know

Leave your details and we'll tell you when reservations open, before anyone else hears about it.

fields.name: consent
fields.label: Consent Text
fields.value: I agree to JSW Motors storing my details and contacting me about the launch, reservations and related updates over email, SMS, WhatsApp and phone, as in the Privacy Notice.

fields.name: redirect
fields.label: Thank-you Page Link
fields.description: Page to redirect to after a successful registration. Internal path (e.g. /thank-you) or a full URL.

fields.name: requestSent
fields.label: Request Sent Pop-up
fields.description: Booking only (used when the Thank-you Page Link is empty). The heading is the pop-up's title (e.g. Request sent to Meridian Motors); each paragraph starting with a bold label is a row (e.g. **Dealer** Meridian Motors, Plot 14, Sector 54, Golf Course Road, Gurgaon); a plain paragraph is the status line (e.g. Waiting for Meridian Motors to call you); a link is the outlined button beside Done (e.g. Explore the Combat to #combat). The visitor's email and contact are added automatically.

fields.name: mapName
fields.label: Map Pop-up Name
fields.description: Booking only. The bold line of the pop-up over the map's pin, e.g. Meridian Motors.

fields.name: mapAddress
fields.label: Map Address
fields.description: Booking only. The address the Google map shows and marks, e.g. Plot 14, Sector 54, Gurgaon; also the pop-up's second line. With it the map replaces the Decorative Image (which stays as the fallback); clicking the map opens the address in Google Maps.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Default: the registration form. Booking: the dealer microsite's quote request: the details (email optional, pincode as in Default), then the OTP and the Request Sent pop-ups; the lead is sent with source Dealer Microsite and channel Digital. The Decorative Image is the map beside it.

fields.name: root
fields.label: Root Path (Optional)
fields.description: Folder to pick articles from, e.g. /blogs/technology.

fields.name: index
fields.label: Query Index Path
fields.description: Index to read articles from, e.g. /news-index.json. Another site's index can be given as a full URL (e.g. https://www.jswmotors.com/news-index.json for a dealer site): its articles then link to that site. That site must allow this one to read it (CORS).

fields.name: show
fields.label: Show
fields.description: Current Page Tags: articles sharing this page's tags (the block is hidden when the page has no tags). Latest articles: the newest articles from the Root Path, whatever their tags.

fields.name: viewAll
fields.label: View All Link (Optional)
fields.description: Page the View all button opens, e.g. /newsroom. The button shows on the right of the heading only when this and the View All Label are both filled in.

fields.name: viewAllLabel
fields.label: View All Label (Optional)
fields.description: Text of the View all button, e.g. View all news. No button when empty.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Center (default): the heading centred over the cards. Left: the eyebrow and heading on the left, then title and summary under each image. In both, the View all button sits on the right of the heading.

fields.name: video
fields.label: Video URL
fields.description: e.g. a Vidyard link: https://play.vidyard.com/...

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Auto-scroll
fields.description: Automatically rotate the deck at a fixed interval. Requires min. 2 cards and max. 12 cards. Strip: a flat row of cards with previous and next buttons instead of the arc (no auto-scroll).

validation.customErrorMsg: Enter an external URL starting with http:// or https://

fields.name: caption
fields.label: Caption
fields.description: Max. 60 character

validation.customErrorMsg: Caption must be 60 characters or fewer.

fields.name: classes
fields.label: Style
fields.description: Combine freely, e.g. Vertical + Pills. Accordion on mobile stacks the tabs below 600px. Specs lays out a spec comparison: give each tab a Fragment holding a Columns block (one column per model; row 1 the model names, every other cell a label and a value as two paragraphs). Locations shows each tab as an image tile: give each tab a city Title and one image as its Content; the open tab's image fills the section. FAQ puts text tabs above the accordions of a Light FAQ section: add the FAQ Tabs block instead of Tabs (its tabs ask only for a Title), or add FAQ Tab items here, then add one Accordion block per tab after the Tabs block in the same section (the first accordion goes in the first tab, and so on), or use a Tab with a Fragment holding an Accordion.

fields.name: defaultTab
fields.label: Open Tab
fields.description: Which tab is open when the page loads (1 = first). A link to #tab-name opens that tab instead.

fields.name: activation
fields.label: Keyboard Activation
fields.description: Automatic opens a tab as the arrow keys reach it. Manual only moves focus, Enter or Space opens it (better when tabs load heavy content).

fields.name: lightMode
fields.label: Light Mode
fields.description: On: the tabs sit on a white card with dark text. Off: they follow the section (light text on the default dark sections).

fields.name: title
fields.label: Tab Title
fields.description: Short label shown on the tab. Also used for the tab's link, e.g. #tab-specifications.

fields.name: fragment
fields.label: Fragment (Optional)
fields.description: Show a fragment's content (any blocks) in this tab, below the Content. It loads when the tab is first opened.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image (Optional)
fields.description: An image shown in this tab's panel.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Tab Title
fields.description: Short label shown on the tab. Its questions are the matching Accordion block after the Tabs block (the first accordion for the first tab, and so on).
